# Livestock of America

> A marketplace and knowledge base for American livestock: animals and studs
> offered for sale by ranch, a breed knowledge base spanning every farmed
> species, a directory of ranches and agricultural businesses, and herd health
> tooling for producers. Operated by Oatmeal AI.

Livestock of America is a single-page React application. Every URL below
returns the same HTML shell and is rendered client side, so fetching a page
without executing JavaScript yields no article text.

## Marketplace

- [Livestock marketplace](https://livestockofamerica.com/marketplaces/livestock): animals for sale and males offered at stud, filterable by species, breed, state and price
- [Ranch and business directory](https://livestockofamerica.com/directory): ranch profiles and agricultural businesses with location and contact details

## Knowledge base

- [Breeds of livestock](https://livestockofamerica.com/livestock): breed profiles by species, with history, characteristics and images
- [Knowledge bases](https://livestockofamerica.com/knowledgebases): the livestock, plant and ingredient knowledge bases

## About

- [About](https://livestockofamerica.com/about): what the site is and who runs it
- [About Oatmeal AI](https://livestockofamerica.com/about/oatmeal-ai): the company behind the site
- [Contact](https://livestockofamerica.com/contact-us): how to get in touch

## Optional

- [News](https://livestockofamerica.com/news): agricultural news feed
- [Blog](https://livestockofamerica.com/blog): long-form posts
- [Over the fence](https://livestockofamerica.com/over-the-fence): community section
